content: LittleFS is now built into arduino-esp32 core (2.x+) — the old lorol/LITTLEFS fork is deprecated/superseded. LittleFS offers better wear-leveling, crash/power-loss resilience, and speed vs SPIFFS; recommended for all new ESP32 projects as of 2025-2026. For append-heavy logging, fixed-size binary records outperform text/CSV in flash-write count.
